request: Build a small Jac web app for a company org chart. Employees report to one manager, and there is exactly one CEO at the top. Users add an employee under a manager, move a person together with everyone under them to a new manager, remove an employee, and look up a person's chain of command and all of their direct and indirect reports. The page shows the chart as a nested tree.
acceptance: Moving a manager under one of their own indirect reports is rejected and the chart stays unchanged.
The chain of command of the CEO is empty; for an employee three levels down it lists exactly three managers, nearest first.
Removing an employee who has reports re-attaches those reports to the removed employee's manager; removing the CEO is rejected.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Model the entities as nodes and the relations as edges; traverse them with walkers or graph queries.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
